regimes.outcome: The income of INR 378,000 is taxable as professional income under the head 'Profits and Gains of Business or Profession'.
The supply of services to a foreign client is exempt from GST as it is an export of services.
The receipt of payment from a foreign client is compliant with FEMA as it is received through an authorized person (bank) and the e-FIRA has been issued.
The INR value of the receipt is determined using the telegraphic transfer buying rate (TTBR) on the specified date, which is 94.50, resulting in an INR value of 378,000.

limits: The exact TTBR on the payment date (2026-06-17) is not provided, and the closest published rate is used.
The e-FIRA details are not provided, but it is assumed to be valid and issued by the bank.
The typed input is used in place of actual documents, which could affect the accuracy of the analysis.
